howto.name: Upload the stamped PDF
howto.text: Select a PDF that carries Bates numbering applied by PrivaTools or another tool.

howto.name: Describe the stamp
howto.text: Give the prefix and any suffix used when the numbers were applied, so the tool matches those stamps and leaves real page content alone. The digit count matters only when both are blank: then anything in the top or bottom inch that looks like letters followed by at least that many digits is removed.

howto.name: Download the clean PDF
howto.text: The matching stamps are removed and the rest of the page is untouched. You download a new PDF; the original on your device is not changed.

faq.q: Will this remove numbering added by another program?
faq.a: Usually, if the stamps were added as text and you can describe their shape: prefix, digit count, suffix. Numbers burned into a scanned image are part of the picture and cannot be lifted this way.

faq.q: Why type the prefix and digits?
faq.a: So the tool removes stamps and nothing else. A bare search for numerals would happily delete page numbers, figures and dates. With a prefix or suffix, only text with exactly that around a number is removed; with both blank, anything in the top or bottom inch shaped like letters and at least the given number of digits goes.

faq.q: Does removing Bates numbers change the rest of the page?
faq.a: No. Only the matching stamp objects are removed; the remaining text, images and layout are untouched. The result is a new PDF, so the file on your device stays as it was.
